def comps_grid(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if (r,c) in seen: continue
   col=g[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
   while q:
    y,x=q.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
    for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
     if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]==col:
      seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
   comps.append((col,pts))
 return comps

def find_marker(g):
 bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
 cand=[]
 for col,pts in comps_grid(g):
  if col==bg or len(pts)<7: continue
  rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]; t,b,l,rr=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs); hh=b-t+1; ww=rr-l+1
  if min(hh,ww)<3: continue
  ss=set(pts)
  edges={'top':sum((t,c) in ss for c in range(l,rr+1)), 'bottom':sum((b,c) in ss for c in range(l,rr+1)), 'left':sum((r,l) in ss for r in range(t,b+1)), 'right':sum((r,rr) in ss for r in range(t,b+1))}
  # two connected perpendicular bbox boundary edges sharing one corner; high coverage
  corners=[('top','left',t,l),('top','right',t,rr),('bottom','left',b,l),('bottom','right',b,rr)]
  for e1,e2,er,ec in corners:
   lengths=(ww if e1 in ('top','bottom') else hh, hh if e2 in ('left','right') else ww)

            hh,ww=bottom-top+1,right-left+1

            pts=set(comp)
            edges={'top':sum((top,c) in pts for c in range(left,right+1)),
                   'bottom':sum((bottom,c) in pts for c in range(left,right+1)),
                   'left':sum((r,left) in pts for r in range(top,bottom+1)),
                   'right':sum((r,right) in pts for r in range(top,bottom+1))}
            for e1,e2,er,ec in [('top','left',top,left),('top','right',top,right),

                n1=ww if e1 in ('top','bottom') else hh

            dist=min(abs(r-y)+abs(c-x) for r,c in comp for y,x in marker)
